display_long_description:
You're a tiny bear.

This is a fairy tale.

All is chaos.

Explore magical worlds packed with weird creatures, giant bosses, hidden treasures, and way too many things you probably shouldn't eat.

# 🍗 EAT THE LOOT
Every magical Tink you find is food. Beat monsters, raid bosses, and stuff your belly with as much loot as you can carry.

# 🚽 FULL? FIND A TOILET!
Extraction works a little differently around here. Sprint to an extraction toilet, flush yourself to safety, and cash out your haul before someone else takes it.

# 🤝 SQUAD UP... OR SELL OUT 
Play with friends or jump into a raid with other players. Share the loot, help each other survive... or decide that legendary treasure is worth losing a few friendships.

# ✨ EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT
Find crazy weapons, magical relics, funny cosmetics, powerful upgrades, and unexpected surprises hiding around every corner.

Only the smartest (or hungriest) bears make it home.

**Eat. Loot. Flush. Repeat.**

**https://discord.gg/fabulavr**
